name: New Exhibitions at Galeria Municipal
description: Be among the first to see two new compelling exhibitions opening this Saturday: "Physical Culture: Porto Edition" by Augustas Serapinas and a new show by Lydia Ourahmane.
longDescription:
On Saturday, July 11, 2026, the Galeria Municipal do Porto opens two new art exhibitions. One features the work of Lithuanian artist Augustas Serapinas, titled "Physical Culture: Porto Edition." Serapinas's practice often involves site-specific interventions and explorations of local contexts. The second exhibition presents new work by Algerian artist Lydia Ourahmane, known for her installations and performances that address themes of migration, memory, and geopolitics.

Visitors to the Galeria Municipal will have the opportunity to view both exhibitions on their opening day. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is a contemporary art space located in the city, known for showcasing both established and emerging artists. The atmosphere is typically focused on art appreciation, with works displayed across the gallery's exhibition spaces.

Admission to both new exhibitions at the Galeria Municipal do Porto is free. The venue is located within walking distance of the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F). The gallery is generally accessible for visitors.
